notes.title: Honor Cry: Aftermath - Price Reduction and New Game Fixes!
notes.content:
Hello Gamers,
Our RPG experience Honor Cry: Aftermath is getting a new lower price ($1.99 once it takes effect) and a new game patch to improve the game itself!

Changes:
- Increased Item Durability 15-30% so that items don't break so fast.
- Made the first few screens a bit easier in terms of enemies so you don't get ambushed by a vastly superior enemy right as you're starting out.
- Made random encounters about 5% less frequent.
- Streamlined combat so that if there's only 1 enemy, you don't have to click on their name every time.
- Made hit chances a bit higher, about 4%.
- Made the main quest in the second swamp area a bit easier by giving the player a hint where to find the Remove Curse scroll, and giving it to them possibly if they fail in the Gamemaster game 3 or more times.

Comments welcomed. Thanks and enjoy!
Derek

notes.title: Version 1.04 released!
notes.content:
This 1.04 revision alters and tweaks some of the game based on player input. The goal was to make it slightly tougher than before.

- Changed the 'Rage Slash' attack so that it now costs 2 Mana and 2 Life points per use, instead of the previous 1 Mana and 1 Life. It was deemed to be too powerful.
- Tweaked the chances of finding healing potions after fights down about 15-20%.
- Tweaked the chances of finding overall items down by 5% after combats.
- Tweaked down the amounts of gold after fights by 5-10%.
- Changed the Diabolus spell so that it now costs 5 Mana and 4 Life to use and it now has a 60% chance to kill -- instead of costing 5 Mana and 2 Life, with a 70% chance to kill.
- Fixed 'of the Tundra' weapon suffix so that it now works properly.

Thanks and comments are always welcomed!
Derek
